title: The Train Ticket
answer: C, the guest. He said his train arrived at midnight, but his ticket was stamped 10:45 PM, so he was there before 11:15.

beats.line: Mr. Price was found dead at his country house. His watch had stopped at exactly 11:15.
Whoever did it was in the house at 11:15.
Suspect A. The driver says he was in the garage all night.
Suspect B. The cook says she was baking bread since ten.
Suspect C. The guest says his train only arrived at midnight.

visual.name: The Guest
visual.alibi: My train got in at midnight.

beats.line: But in the guest's pocket was his train ticket. Stamped at 10:45 PM.
So, who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
